_comment: Hand-curated leads. Every entry is imported as DISCOVERED / UNREVIEWED and is never shown in the app until it passes validation AND an admin approves the licensing. 'handle_confirmed' says whether the YouTube handle was confirmed from an independent public listing; unconfirmed handles are resolved and pinned by the validator and must be checked by the admin during review. kind 'link' = channel is only streamed inside the broadcaster's own platform (login/DRM/region); TVKu only opens that official page, it never plays or embeds it.
